messages.content:
<question>
In the lease es-lease-02, a Valencia flat let by a company for three years, clause 5 asks the tenant for an additional guarantee of two months' rent, EUR 1,960, on top of a one-month deposit. Is that allowed?
</question>

<answer>
Colombia: Under Colombian rules for residential leases, a landlord may ask for an additional guarantee on top of the security deposit, but its value may not exceed one month's rent. A guarantee of two months' rent, EUR 1,960, would therefore be above that limit.
</answer>

<reference>
Yes. Besides the cash deposit of one month's rent, the parties may agree any additional guarantee, and in a housing lease of up to five years (up to seven if the landlord is a legal person) its value may not exceed two months' rent (art. 36.5 of the Ley de Arrendamientos Urbanos), which is exactly what the clause asks.
</reference>
